key_insight: Machine learning can accurately predict band gaps across diverse halide perovskite families and reveal which atomic and structural descriptors most strongly control them.
engineering_relevance: These models can speed up lead-free perovskite screening by guiding composition and structure choices before costly synthesis and characterization.
method: Trained ensemble tree-based regressors on atomic and structural descriptors.
Compared RFR, GBRT, and XGB for band gap prediction.
Used feature importance to identify dominant B-site/X-site and stoichiometric drivers.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong predictive accuracy across multiple halide perovskite types, with evaluation based on regression model performance.
watch_item: Feature importance from tree ensembles can indicate correlations rather than fully causal physical mechanisms, so results should be validated with external data and domain analysis.
paper_title: Machine learning insights into band gap properties in halide-based perovskites
